name: magicore-benchmark-unified
description: Unified 20-package manifest for fair PM comparison (mgc/npm/pnpm/bun)

_notes.why_20_packages: Industry standard benchmark size - enough complexity to show PM performance differences without being unwieldy
_notes.why_not_vitest: mgc v1.0 has known P0 issue with vitest causing illegal hardware instruction crash. Replaced with Jest (similar functionality, stable).
_notes.why_jest: Jest is most popular JS test framework (40M+ weekly downloads), widely supported by all package managers, no known compatibility issues.
_notes.package_count: 10 dependencies + 10 devDependencies = 20 direct packages (plus ~200-250 transitive dependencies)
_notes.use_case: Typical Next.js + React + TypeScript project with common utilities, form handling, styling, and testing
